primary_outcome: three-draw mean energy, force, or stress MAE
normalization: negative MAE, min-max normalized within system, test distribution, budget, and endpoint
interpretation_boundary: The bridge uses only exact numerical entries from Tables 1--4 and does not digitize learning-curve figures.
The in-distribution test partition is drawn from the entropy-driven pool, while the independent test emphasizes equilibrium and thermal-MD configurations.
The post-outcome carbon mixed-pool remedy is excluded because its composition was designed after observing the independent-test reversal.
Three reported draws combine training-subset and optimizer variation; individual seed outcomes are not released in the source tables.
